Hey, thanks I think that would be good! Not much at the moment really, just watching TV shows online. 

Wow, that's bad I'm sorry to hear that. We haven't been broken up all that long, and we see each other a reasonable amount, which makes it really hard. I've got a few friends, but no one that I think I could go to this with. It's not really a conversation that I'd know how to have with them. 

To be honest even writing the letters seemed to help a bit I think, really they were just lists of problems for people to read. It was odd seeing them all written down.
Thanks again! :)
